latest.title: Floor plans in Find a location
latest.summary: Each building the finder lists now names its layout, and the map window shows the game's own floor plan for it: hover a row to see its layout light up on a shelf of every shop, office or warehouse layout drawn at one scale, with its floor area, capacity and entrances (loading bays for a warehouse). Click a layout on the shelf to list only buildings with that layout. On a phone, pick a row and switch the map window to Plan.
